organization.name: Heroku (Salesforce)
organization.notes: Heroku founded 2007. Official about page inconsistently says acquired 2011 in prose but December 2010 in timeline; ownership by Salesforce is clear. Historical $3m 2008 funding names Redpoint; not a current equity ownership claim.

pricingTiers.name: Basic dyno
pricingTiers.notes: Always-on Basic $7/month, prorated runtime where applicable. Eco is a separate $5 sleeping personal-only option. Databases and add-ons extra; no annual contract inferred.
No public Most popular or Recommended plan designation found in the source inspected; no popularity inferred.

pricingTiers.name: Standard-1X dyno
pricingTiers.notes: Closest production/team compute tier; $25 per dyno/month. Not total team deployment cost; databases, add-ons and any team fee separate.

pricingTiers.name: Heroku Enterprise
pricingTiers.notes: Tailored enterprise offering; total requires vendor quote. Published dyno rates are not a complete enterprise contract.

moats.claim: Buildpacks, add-ons and Salesforce data integrations create practical workflow and integration switching costs.

productReasons.claim: Language buildpacks turn source into runnable applications across multiple language ecosystems.
Add-ons and unified logs/metrics connect application components with troubleshooting workflows.
AppLink connects custom application logic to Salesforce flows, Apex and Agentforce actions.
